refnamediv.refpurpose: Sets the default timezone used by all date/time functions in a script

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
booldate_default_timezone_set stringtimezoneId
date_default_timezone_set sets the default timezone used by all date/time functions.
Instead of using this function, you can also use the INI setting date.timezone to set the default timezone. Unlike setting date.timezone in php.ini, which applies to every request by default, date_default_timezone_set only affects the current request; and if both are used in the same request, date_default_timezone_set takes precedence regardless of the order they were called in.

&reftitle.errors;
If the timezoneId is not a valid timezone identifier, an E_NOTICE is emitted, and this function returns &false;.
